title: Morphisms between geometric points are exactly stalk-point 2-morphisms
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\bar{x}:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ and $\bar{y}:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'\to S$ be geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $p_x$ and $p_y$ be the associated points of the small étale topos $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$, with inverse images given by geometric stalk functors [lem-trf-etale-topos-points-geometric]. The assignment sending a morphism of geometric points $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'$ with $a\circ\bar{y}=\bar{x}$ to the induced natural transformation of stalk functors (equivalently, its adjoint 2-morphism $p_x\Rightarrow p_y$) is a bijection from such scheme morphisms to 2-morphisms between $p_x$ and $p_y$. Every such 2-morphism is invertible, because the induced map on every étale stalk is bijective.
